rows.evidence: Q1: Sections 2.2-2.3 <U+2014> authors collected 50 and 33 topsoil samples (0-10 cm) on 8 May and 12 June 2022 in a 5.34 ha mulched drip-irrigated cotton field in Wujiaqu, measured EC1:5 in the lab and flew a Nano-Hyperspec UAV sensor; own PSO-GPR model runs. Q2: Section 3.6 and Table 4 <U+2014> the 0.7-order FOD + BOSS PSO-GPR model achieved test-set R2 0.9201, RMSE 0.1535 dS/m, RPD 3.54 against measured EC1:5; Section 3.7 / Fig. 11 <U+2014> the model was used to map 0-10 cm salinity at emergence and squaring periods. Q8: Section 4.4 <U+2014> authors state the limited size of the study area restricted inclusion of environmental factors such as parent material and regional variation in salt composition; only 400-1000 nm UAV data used, lacking NIR/SWIR; no integration with ground spectra or satellite data; cover (film, vegetation) interferes with and mixes the spectral signal.
rows.notes: The study supports the monitoring/prediction part of the claim (R2 0.92, RMSE 0.15 dS/m). The 'reinforcing irrigation management and salinization mitigation' part is only asserted in the abstract/discussion (listing amendments, intercropping, deep tillage as possible measures) and not tested. Q3 no: a single method (UAV hyperspectral regression) validated against lab EC; the lab EC is the reference, not an independent estimate of the effect. Q4 no: the mechanism (salinity reduces chlorophyll/water uptake, altering canopy reflectance) is asserted in Section 3.2 but chlorophyll or plant water status is not measured. Q5/Q6 no: one field (5.34 ha), one region, one crop, two dates. Q7 no: the recommendation to use a differential order below 1.0 and the EC1:5-total salt correlation are methodological observations rather than stated conditions for the effect. Q9 no: only RMSE/R2/RPD reported; 20 random splits were run but only the best model is reported, no dispersion across runs; GPR confidence intervals mentioned in methods but not reported for the result.

notes: Full text appears complete. Study is a UAV hyperspectral soil salinity prediction study in a single mulched drip-irrigated cotton field in Xinjiang; it is a monitoring study, not an intervention study on salinization mitigation.
